method: Allowlisted structured extraction, bounded command logs, exact private-profile credential comparison without exporting values, and credential-pattern scanning. The runtime browser export was separately checked against that context credential and cookies before closure.
limitations: Pattern checks do not prove the absence of every possible secret.
Credential prefixes require a token boundary; the earlier broad sk- pattern also matched three space-grotesk font asset names.
Images are not covered by text scanning. Selected current screenshots were visually inspected; no full-image OCR scan was run.
Synthetic UI conversations and plans remain as acceptance evidence; native transcripts and activity summaries are excluded.
